title: After-Hours Removal Charge on Homeowner Service Contracts Replacements
content:
**Rule.** An after-hours removal charge is added to the disposal charge for the haul-away of equipment Bridgewell replaced under a Homeowner Service Contract, because the old unit is carried out at the installation visit held in the window the replacement request asked for:

| Window the replacement request asked for | Request urgency | After-hours removal charge |
|---|---|---|
| after-hours | emergency | 30.00 |
| after-hours | routine | 20.00 |
| business-hours | either | nothing |

The visit window and the urgency are those recorded on the replacement request.

*Q. A routine request asked for a business-hours visit — is any removal charge added?* No; nothing is added for a business-hours visit.
*Q. An emergency request asked for an after-hours visit?* 30.00 is added.
